snippet.title: Loaded Dice - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Just dropped the trailer for the game I'm solo developping: Loaded Dice.

A dice roguelike where Yahtzee meets Balatro and Slay the Spire. Roll, build combos, explode your multipliers.

Free demo live on Steam.

#indiegame #roguelike #gamedev #balatro #slaythespire
